expectedOutcome: Revalidate current UserPolicy + PrivacyCheckpoint, prepare a citation-preserving local export, and present the system share controller. On its actual presentation callback write creationSharePresented with typed exportFormat and sharePresented=true; payload readiness is not presentation. Preparation or pre-callback presentation failure maps to L2 with sharePresented=false. Dismissal after presentation is not failure. If audit persistence fails after presentation, retain the true presentation fact and enqueue an idempotent content-free L2 retry. Never record activityType, target App, completion, content, assetID or sourceLocator (US-SYN-003, ADR-020).
